notes.title: HOTFIX v1.2.2
notes.content:
[b]ACCESSIBILITY MODE CHANGES[/b]

Thanks to Steven Spohn (Spawn), we got a lot of constructive criticism regarding the way we described the former accessibility mode. We wanted to address those issues right away and apologise to anyone who felt offended by it. Here is what we did:

[list]
[*] [b]It is now called “Zen Mode”[/b]: It was pointed to us that accessibility could imply that everyone who needs accessibility options wants an easier game, and that is not true. We now call it Zen Mode because it is an overall more relaxing way to play the game and we think it is more descriptive that way. 
[*] [b]It has a new description:[/b] This was the major offender in this issue and, again, we are sorry by the way that description was phrased. It read like the game was judging or punishing you for turning that on, and that was far from our intention. Here is the new version of the description:

[i]“Zen Mode reduces the difficulty of the game by making you more resistant and tuning down time-related mechanics, allowing you to focus on having fun! Turn this on to have a less stressful experience or for any other reason you desire! Want to proceed?”[/i]

[*][b]It will no longer block any achievements:[/b] We were initially afraid that people would exploit this option to get the achievements fast. By the end of the day we figured that if that was the cost for allowing everyone to experience the entire content, it was totally worth it. The game is at its best when it is challenging (not impossible) for you and your teammates, so have that always in mind before when deciding to use the Zen mode. 
[*] [b]It can be turned on and off during matches:[/b] This was not possible because of the achievement limitations. Now they are gone, you are free to test them out on the fly! Note that this only works in local matches. We are studying ways to allow Zen Mode in online matches in the future, but it is not possible at the moment.
[/list]

We’ve learned a lot today and we figured it would be interesting to share the reasons behind every change with you all. That way we can all keep working to have more accessible games in the future.  

[b]WORKAROUND FOR CHINESE PLAYERS[/b]

We added a warning to instruct players on how to deal with the “stuck at the menu” issue that is currently affecting players from China. This is sadly not a fix, because the issue is caused by corrupt data sent by Windows itself and the game needs that data in multiple moments to properly work. We’ll keep on searching for a more definitive fix, but in the meantime, we thought it would be better to instruct everyone facing this issue on how to work around it. If you missed the solution, you can find it at 可怕的秀逗's post:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/400080/discussions/0/3118147979136942861/

notes.title: Out of Space: Mutations Update! (v1.2)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Hope you have been enjoying Out of Space so far, because we are here to bring some exciting news :D

OUT OF SPACE ON CONSOLES!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/399981042df10d4a9b188d40073dd717dd623439.png[/img]

You’ve been asking us quite frequently when Out of Space would be released on consoles, and now the answer for that question is TODAY! Out of Space: Couch Edition is now available for Nintendo Switch, Playstation 4 and Xbox One, so prepare to take your housecleaning team to the living room. 

The Couch Edition is an offline only version of the game and it has every local content ever released for PC, including the new aliens from todar’s update. We really hope those of you that have been waiting to mop aliens around a lot of fun with the console version as well! And now, to the Mutations update content :)

FIVE NEW ALIEN TYPES!

These aliens have been extensively tested in the beta branch and we can safely assure you they will spice your matches up. From now on, every time a regular alien starts mutating, it will hatch out as one out of six total mutated aliens, including the already known Flying Alien. The combination of the aliens that can be found inside rooms will certainly make each match feel more unique and challenging than ever!

Here is the full list of the alien types currently available:

Regular Alien

This is how every alien in the game is born and most of you are well acquainted with them. Cockroach-like creatures that walk around the house, gooing the floor and powering off your rooms. They are not violent towards players but that does not mean they are not dangerous.

Spitter

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/61fb299ae253524e47f4647b618e82c012ace25e.png[/img]

Used to be the only type of mutation in the game. They will attack players on sight, flying in their direction and spitting goo until you are nothing but a jumping cocoon. They are also very vulnerable to buckets of water, but mop attacks won’t reach them. 

Swimmer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/0e9d5c856cddee6740fc24f8a8036d2b7c9f0b4a.png[/img]

These aliens evolved to not only be resistant to, but to thrive on contact with water. Hitting them with water will increase their movement speed, make them fearless and even wake them up from previous stuns. 

Bulky 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/4324d9789073b387c99d1e1b75b928f302b212b0.png[/img]

These resistant creatures are invulnerable to mop hits until their shells are temporarily softened with a bucket of water. One needs to act fast, though, because the shell will harden back to it’s invulnerable state in no time.

Spiky

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/a208c9e9ebfc43f05eb1aa12503bcd544ddd0c05.png[/img]

Mutated aliens with spikes on their shells. They are just as vulnerable to attack as regular aliens, but touching them - which includes grabbing and bumping into them - will get players dirty. Oh, and remember to carry them with caution, otherwise your friends might get hurt.

Leader

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/ec611565cac8c5829a7bdf8487343daf7aeaa924.png[/img]

Do not let it’s fancy looks fool you, these aliens are not playing around. They give movement speed to nearby aliens and encourage them, granting them invulnerability to dog barks. You do not want to face an army of aliens led by these royal fellas, believe me.  

Snoozer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/dc34a85738cd53642902606b1c7df619c69496d3.png[/img]

With snoozing spores being released from their back, these mutated aliens will constantly drain your energy until you can’t help but fall asleep. Countless cases of house owners having their house destroyed while they are unconscious have been reported and blamed on Snoozers, so avoid getting too close while the spores are still active. 

If you want to know more or to test our games before release, please join us on our official [url=discord.gg/beholdstudios] Discord Server [/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.1

tags.feature: [COM] The tutorial is now completely optional and we added a new unlockable as a reward to those that finish it :D
[COM] Added a new Armchair skin to the game;

[COM] All the available servers were now added to the settings options and are applicable to any private game! The current list includes Asia, Australia, Canada-East, China, Europe, India, Japan, South Korea, Russia, Russia-East, South America, USA-East and USA-West.
[COM] Now all steam achievements will be synced with the in game achievements from time to time, to avoid discrepancies;
We now introduce the accessibility mode right after the tutorial, to make sure no one suffers through the difficulty of the game unnecessarily;

tags.balance_change: Increased the amount of times some of the information is sent during online matches to reduce disconnections due to package loss;
[COM] Buckets now have the same priority level as mops when you try to grab them (it is easier to swap between them now because of that);
The Pumpkin Garden no longer destroys the item over it when it is deconstructed;
The countdown that happens when making a lobby private is now reduced when there is only the host inside the said lobby;
Aliens can now push objects away, so they should not get stuck on trash bags or boxes anymore;
[COM] The Cleaner Bot cannot be picked up by players anymore, since that had little use and caused many accidental grabs;
[COM] We’ve implemented an improved deadzone on controller analogs to prevent it from turning the player to the wrong side when throwing a Bucket of water;
[COM] Both Chef and Watering bots will now show the “out of power” balloon until they are fully charged, so players don’t think it is just unresponsive;
The adaptive music is now improved and has more possible players (this should be more noticeable at the start of matches);
Alien eggs can now spawn both at doors and on the dirty floor at any given time (it was previously limited to one or another, depending on the game state);
Flying Aliens were slightly buffed to make their presence more impactful in the game:
Some of them may wait a bit before rushing to attack players, making those one-bucket-stuns-all-aliens moves harder to pull off (and more rewarding when you do);
Their spits hit a bit harder, from ¼ of the dirtiness limit to ⅓. This does not affect the damage you take when stepping over the goo they spit on the floor.
The amount of dirt it spits on the floor was also slightly increased;
[COM] Doors between a powered room and a corridor can now spawn aliens if it is dirty (having a door like that as the only dirty door is no longer harmless);
[COM] The Chef Bot no longer takes raw fruits to players when they are hungry, only cooked food and pizza;

[COM] The Watering Bot will no longer clean something that has just been cleaned by another bot (like three of them cleaning the same shaft) This was causing a severe drop in performance and had to be postponed to a hotfix or to the next patch;
[COM] Both the Chef Bot and the Watering Bot will no longer go charge until they have not holding any items;
Both the Chef Bot and the Watering Bot now have more energy to spend before having to recharge;
The bandwidth cost of having too many aliens on screen during an online match is now split between all players in an attempt to make the game lighter on the host’s connection;
[COM] Aliens no longer destroy buckets that are over sinks when they attack the sink itself;
The challenge “item madness” has now a reduced chance of spawning batteries and a higher chance of spawning aliens (we thought it was helping players too much);

tags.bug: [COM] Using the bucket while highly fatigued now properly cleans the floor, even if the player falls asleep at the moment they throw the water;
Fixed a bug that set the Mixer in an infinite loop of accepting multiple inputs but never producing any battery;
[COM] The shop is now automatically closed if the player that is using it “dies” for any reason;
[COM] Shafts no longer drip goo when it is clean;
Buckets can no longer rotate when they are dropped by Watering Bots (only a visual issue);
Rooms and corridors no longer get dirty when they go out of the screen (there was yet another thing triggering that);
[COM] Fixed issue preventing players from inviting others after starting matchmaking and making the lobby private again (they would get a “waiting for server” message);
[COM] Fixed problem that would show the weekly challenge checkbox for new players instead of properly hiding it until the challenge is unlocked;
[COM] Spending money on the shop no longer pops unnecessary numbers in the interface of online players (as if it was adjusting the value constantly);
[COM] The “dirty” effect is now properly displayed on dog beds, Chef and Watering Bots’ bases;
Players can no longer pet the dog while holding food;
[COM] Fixed the “host” key icon showing up for more than one player on lobbyies;
Lamp’s hologram no longer taunts the Aliens;

notes.title: Out of Space: Robotics update! (v.1.1.0)

tags.feature: You can now buy two new robots to help you on your daily tasks! Each will automize part of processes that can lead you to be overwhelmed during a match at the cost of building a proper setup for them to work.

tags.bug: The input used to click the start match button no longer defines the controller you need to use on the match (it would sometimes prevent some controllers from working);
Rooms now only become active when a player open its doors (instead of when you wash the doors), as a way to make opening the room a more surprising and exciting moment;
Shafts will sync up their animation stages more often, to avoid inconsistency with the visuals and its logical state;
The system made to teleport lost items back to players now requires them to be a bit higher (so items don’t teleport needlessly);
The collision area of some appliances were reduced to make it easier to walk around the ship;
The value of the money made by recycling or using the bike now “pops” closer to the appliances themselves, interface wise.

Recycling appliances now only give back 35% of their value on the shop (down from 50%);
In single player, it had its value per tick reduced from 5 to 4;
In multiplayer, the value per tick was reduced from 5 to 3;
In multiplayer, the time between ticks was slightly increased;

Now the bike grants a bonus 1 for each players using an exercise bike simultaneously and in the same room as you are (for instance, having 4 players on bikes that are on the same room will get 3+3 per tick each);
Nightstand from 20 to 10;
Shower from 25 to 20;
Couch from 22 to 20;
Exercising Bicycle from 25 to 15;
Power outlet from 15 to 10;
Spray from 15 to 10;

tags.bug: Changed the maximum number of items the Refrigerator can store from 21 to 20 (the 21th was allowed due to a bug, to be honest);
Fixed the issue causing cocooned players getting teleported to themselves and causing the camera do flicker frantically;
Fixed that *slightly annoying* issue causing some online players to be unable to lay down on Couches, Beds and Armchairs on the first time in interact with them;
Some key interface elements on the menus no longer block other buttons while playing on ultrawide resolutions;
Tables no longer get items stuck on players during online games;

Items no longer get stuck on Recyclers if the player using it falls asleep or starving;
Fixed the fog problem that made some rooms always visible, even if deactivated;
The “ready” status on lobbies now reset when an online player leaves said lobby;
The “Supply and Demand” challenge now increases prices as it should, starting from 25 and raising by 10 each time you buy a given item;
Fixed problem causing multiple players to spawn on the same spot at the start of the matches;

Fixed issue causing the Cleaning Bot to respawn in the wrong place when players moved its base to another room;

The tooltip that appears when pressing info while holding an Alien now displays the correct text;
The Plant’s buff effect is now destroyed after you deconstruct it;
The Watering Bot no longer insists in cleaning cocooned players with the bucket;

This may cause some items to be rotated in a different way when comparing the host game with other players’, but it should not damage the gameplay in no significant way (please tell us if it does, though).

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2

notes.title: Out of Space update: Weekly Challenges! v0.8.10
notes.content:
Hi everyone! How about some new challenges to bring more variety to the game? The weekly challenges are here and we are eager to see how many of you will manage to beat them. As usual, items tagged as [COM] were changed based on community feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/2e1a1d3e306b74686fd829d36a6e6913a20f7e9f.png[/img]

[b]WEEKLY CHALLENGES[/b]

[COM] Many of you have been asking for additional challenges in the game. Some asked for new achievements, some for hardcore modes, some for infinite matches, but of all those great requests, the one we’ve been looking forward the most were the weekly challenges! 

This is a special type of match that will bring a new combination of modifiers to the game each week, always in a large ship that will be the same for everyone who plays them. Every challenge will randomize 3 out of a pool of game modifiers that can make the game both easier and harder, depending on how well the players can adapt their strategies. Here are some examples of the modifiers:
[list]
[*] Item Madness: Every item generated by either cleaning, cultivating, cooking or mixing is random;
[*] Free Market: all prices at the shop are random;
[*] Dirty Plumbing: buckets have a chance of being filled up with goo instead of water at faucets and sinks;
[*] Many other variants that can be combined to create somewhat mind boggling challenges =)
[/list]
Other types of challenges and those requests I mentioned above may still come in the future, but with the weekly challenges here, we now have a better structure to support them as they come. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33859462/b31d9d5b8f6ebd7bb2729726d6ced3e0795794fa.gif[/img]

[b]CHANGES AND ENHANCEMENTS[/b]

Interface[list]
[*] [COM] You can now choose from the skins you have available before buying anything in the shop. This new option is available by pressing;
[/list]

Bug Fixes[list]

[/list]

We didn't have much time to bug-fix this week, to be honest. We'll get back 

If you want to know more or participate testing features before release, please join us on our official [url=discord.gg/beholdstudios] Discord Server [/url].

tags.feature: From now on, every alien can potentially transform into a more evolved and aggressive form. The Flying Aliens (we might give it a better name in the future haha) will fly around the room, spitting goo at players and eventually hitting appliances in the process. We wanted an Alien that would make encounters more diverse and thrilling, even for more experienced players.

The bug busters? I guess.. Anyway, now the game has an awesome new way to deal with the alien goo and the spawns: the Quarantine Spray! It can be used to protect appliances from aliens, block doors to avoid spawns, make players temporarily immune to dirt or cause Aliens to flee from you while you spray it around like crazy!

It is also the first consumable item in the game, meaning every time you apply it somewhere (by holding down use the button, much like disassembling something), it will be gone forever! I mean, you can still buy another one at the shop, if you want to. And in case you want to make them interactable again, you can just wash the quarantine effect off with a water bucket and get on with your life.

Oh, and appliances on quarantine will become non-interactive but will keep working as they should. Passive buffs, for instance, will keep their effects on sprayed decorations. We hope you all enjoy this new defensive tool and make the best out of it!
The Dog now drinks water from the bucket as long as it is close to it. Works pretty similar to the food on the floor, filing its energy, but leaving the bucket empty after a few seconds;
It also eats food in its pot as long as the pot is within range;
All foods will be entirely consumed when the Dog eats them in its food pot;

Walking Aliens are now capped to send two “walking animation SFXs” at once, reducing the number of overlapping sounds that harmed performance so bad;
Players need to be a bit closer to a sound source to listen to it, something that also reduces the overlapping sound issue;
We’ve removed many checks that were processed every frame so the game eats less processing power at any given time;

Things that would grow in numbers through a match, the Aliens for instance, were optimized in a way that having an overcrowded ship won’t necessarily mean a 70% performance drop anymore :) The game still becomes a bit slower as more things are being processed and rendered on screen, but not as drastically as before.

notes.title: Some words to our Chinese community!
notes.content:
[b]`zh-CN`[/b]

嘿！各位玩家大家好啊，这份更新日志和以往略有不同，因为我们有些事情想告诉我们来自于中国的玩家们。
首先，我们非常高兴能看到这么多人喜欢玩 Out Of Space，同时也非常感谢你们提供的 BUG 反馈以及其他帮助！

当然了，我们的游戏尚处在 EA (抢先体验) 阶段，所以玩家的反馈对于游戏的开发帮助至关重要，尤其是来自中国玩家的反馈，正因如此，我们才得以完成下述更新修正：

- 由 Discord 社群成员重新进行翻译和校对的简体中文支持 (v0.8.03b12)
- 暂时移除了“邀请好友”的按钮，这样就不会让人感觉这是个 BUG 或者点了没用啦，毕竟这个功能还没有正式发布 (v0.8.03b14)

除此之外，我们还要说明一个事情，为了优化多人游戏匹配的质量，我们针对在游戏中使用简体中文的玩家进行了一种类似于（但并不是，下文有详细说明）锁区的匹配优化机制，这也就是说，当使用简体中文进行游戏时，玩家将仅会匹配到同样使用简体中文的玩家，这也就意味着只能匹配到国内玩家啦，这么做的原因主要是为了规避多人连线中的网络问题。

由于我们的多人模式开发使用的插件是 Photon，该插件中有说明表示 “中国地区与其他地区的多人连线可能存在不稳定，或失效的情况”。所以对于这种连线不稳定的情况，我们也希望玩家能够予以理解。当然，你也可以通过修改游戏语言为英语，来进行任意地区的多人匹配，不过我们不太推荐这么做。

当然，对于大家的帮助，我们再次表示衷心的感谢！爱你们！

Behold Team <3

PS: Thanks to RD_Jaw and 月妹红moko for helping us with the translation of this post as well!


[b]EN [/b]

Hi everyone! This post is especially, although not exclusively, for our players from China. We are very happy and surprised to see so many of you playing Out of Space and helping us with so many bug reports and feedbacks! 

As most of you know, we are still in Early Access and your help is extremely important in improving the game for everyone, specially for other Chinese players. Based on your feedbacks, we’ve already sent the following Hot Fixes:

- An improved version of the Chinese translation checked by the lovely members of 
our Discord Community (v0.8.03b12);
- We removed the “invite friends” button from the matchmaking screen, so people won’t feel like the feature is bugged or not working instead of just not released (v0.8.03b14).


We also need to tell you that we’ve implemented a sort of Region Lock for those who play the game in the Chinese language. That prevents those players to find games in regions that are not China itself and the reason behind that is solely to avoid connection issues with our network system. 


Photon, that is our multiplayer plug in, says that connections between China and other regions are unreliable and might not work. We’d rather you to have a consistent connection in this particular case. Changing the game to English would allow you to connect in any server, but we do not recommend you to do so. 

Thanks once again for all the help! 
Behold Team <3

[COM] As said in our community server, this was one of those features we always knew the game needed, but we only just got to a point in which it is possible to implement it. It’s supposed to be something pretty simple to understand: at the start, part of the content that was available in the game until the last update will be unavailable. It will all become available again once the players unlock achievements like playing some matches, recycling a given number of items or even winning a match without cooking anything.

- Aliens AI reworked to behave more like it is trying to protect itself from the players and to have less predictable movements. They are also more responsive and active, to be more of a threat when left by themselves in rooms.
- Changes on how the music gets compressed, reducing the size of the game and optimizing the loading time for sound effects and music in general.

- The positions of the items that are queued on the Recycler has been improved not to look as if they were floating above it;
- The tables are now properly fixed on online games;
- Object physics no longer go crazy when used in the Recycler;

- Appliances no longer behave as if they were powerless when they are connected to an active energy socket. This fix will also reduce other syncing problems like when a pumpkin garden would produce fruits for one of the players.

notes.content:
Hi everyone! The patch notes for the version v0.7.01 are here! And we are finally releasing the online multiplayer for Out of Space, kind of. Items tagged as [COM] were changed based on community feedback, by the way.

[h1][b]ONLINE MULTIPLAYER (BETA)[/b]
[/h1]
We did plan on having online multiplayer since the start of the project, but it is fair to say that the community was what prevented us from giving up on this feature. The amount of work and headache that implementing this has been enormous, but we knew many of you needed this to play with your friends and here it is.

Unfortunately, we will only release the online multiplayer build in the BETA branch because we've not reached the state we wanted with it yet and we don't want people inadvertently facing heavy bugs on the main branch. Please, if you want to play it on beta nonetheless, expect there to be bugs! We are working hard to make the online experience as fluid as possible, but we are not too close from that point as we thought we were. So have that “beta” mindset when playing an online match and please report any bugs or problems you encounter along the way!

On how to put the game in the BETA Branch and play the online mode, please, check the video below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8JjrzZfqYgM

Shop

notes.title: New Difficulty Director Update! v0.6.04b6
notes.content:
Hi everyone! The patch notes for the version v0.6.04b6 are here! The major focus of this sprint was the Difficulty Director and the features that surround it! Items tagged as [COM] were changed based on community feedback.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/dd5702c18e666d74ff74ded80f489762955d34c3.gif[/img]

[h1]READY, STEADY.. CLEAN![/h1]

 We felt like Out of Space lacked a more controlled pacing to its difficulty. Whether the match is easy, hard, boringly harmless or completely impossible seems totally out of our hands right now and we addressed that issue. 

Hence the Difficulty Director, an AI implemented in this update that both provides dynamic difficulty to the game and sets up moments of peace amidst all the chaos caused by the aliens. We want it to make the game challenging but not relentlessly so. We will be constantly interacting with its values based on the players’ feedbacks, but the should feel less tense and more interesting now. 

[h1]THE VENTILATION SHAFT[/h1]

Ventilation Shafts are an alternative way for dirt to spread in your space house. With a clear anticipation and in a totally preventable way, the ducts can eject dirt from the ventilation directly into that shiny floor of yours. Cautious players need not to worry, though. Keeps the ducts clean with a water bucket will keep your friends and your belongings safe =)

As of this version, it will get the floor and any worstation near it dirty from time to time if unattended. The frequency of that may vary depending on the dynamic and progressive difficulties of the game. 


[h1]CHANGES AND ENHANCEMENTS[/h1]

- [COM] You can now choose your character on the matchmaking screen! This long awaited feature is finally here. You can use L1/R1 (or equivalent) or Q/E to do so.  

- The alien model was optimized to support more detailed and expressive animations.

- Enhanced animation for sleeping on couches, beds and on the floor. Transition animations were also improved to avoid weird moments like when a character floats away from the bed.

- Enhanced animation for opening doors, so that the character doesn’t step outside the door area anymore. That makes it more consistent if the character is going to get dirty or not by opening doors.

- New animations for falling from hunger and for waiting to get fed on the floor. We used to have the same animation for both this and sleeping on the floor.

- Recycler’s collider reduced to prevent it from blocking a door regardless of the position it was built in.

- [COM] Bucket’s animation is now more responsive and no longer delays before actually throwing the water. This should improve the players’ control over where it hits. 

- New visual effect for the Fog that covers closed rooms. Now it has an animation and a variant opacity so the players can still barely see what is inside the rooms.

- Doors of abandoned rooms now get dirty regardless of alien interactions, turning into possible spawn points for alien eggs.

- Enemies no longer hide under appliances. They only interact with them for a while in order to get them dirty and then keep living their lives. 

- The objects now have more thrust and gravity applied to them, meaning they will behave in a more believable way and boxes flying like cannonballs upon a Broom hit will no longer be seen all the time. 

- [COM] Dirty system on the floor was enhanced to reduce the chances of invisible dirt and inconsistent feedback regarding the act of cleaning. 

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

General
- Alien flee speed was increased from 2,5 to 4 and its flee distance was increased from 7 to 15, meaning it has now a higher chance of leaving a room and reaching other places in the house.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- [COM] Mop no longer flickers when players hold it.
- Rooms now consider the next room’s max alien number before spawning eggs there. 
- [COM] The Pumpkin Garden can now be deconstructed anytime.
- The Pumpkin Garden’s highlight doesn’t apply to the particle visual effects.
- The Lamp now turns off its light when out of power.
- Television now behaves properly when out of power.
- Mixer no longer stops working when disassembled and reassembled in another room. 
- [COM] Power Outlets are now more consistent, meaning rooms without energy or with a socketless outlet shouldn’t appear as much as before. 
- Alien Eggs that hatch on doors will no longer explode in dirt, to prevent it from affecting the other room as well as the intended one. This is a temporary fix that will possibly be reworked in the future. 
- [COM] Water from the bucket no longer goes through the doors.
- Aliens have a new icon that shows when they are stored in Refrigerators.

notes.title: Out of Space - Feng Shui Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/2e446efbcf3f17f812d6757d9170115030115be0.png[/img]

Hi everyone! The patch notes for the version v0.6.03b8 are here! This update brings an important feature to the game: decorations with passive buffs!

[h1]NEW DECORATIONS[/h1]

As we said before in our community, we’ve always loved the idea of letting players decorate their space-homes. When we gave up on the coziness bar, though, we felt like decorating for aesthetic customization alone was not enough to encourage players to buy decorations.

To fix that, decorations will now grant passive buffs, whether globally or in a certain area, affecting the player or the environment. 

The buffs are the following:

- [b]Bookshelf[/b]: makes appliances (that require energy) more efficient. Generally speaking, the time they require to clean, cook, process or recharge is greatly reduced. At the time of this patch, the amount of reduction is at 50%. 

- [b]Lamp[/b]: Aliens are slowed when affected by its light. This debuff to aliens is applied in the entire room, reducing their speed by 50%.
 
- [b]Nightstand[/b]: makes armchairs, sofas and beds in that room decrease player’s fatigue 50% faster.

- [b]Plant[/b]: slowly reduces the fatigue of the players in the room over time. In this particular version, it restores 5 per second. 

- [b]Portraits[/b]: eating in the room satiate the player 25% more and also satiate friends in the same room for 40% of the base value of the food ingested.

- [b]Rug[/b]: creates a safe area over the rug that is invulnerable to dirt. The floor still needs to be clean by the time you assemble the rug, though. 
 
- [b]TV[/b]: adds a 60% discount to a random item at the shop. This discount is applied to one item for every TV in the ship and two televisions won’t ever choose the same item to apply the discount on. The chosen items will be randomized again every 60 seconds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/e31c1cad18e85d4aabd446776dfe2cdd481049ae.gif[/img]

[h1]LOCALIZATION SHEET IS NOW AVAILABLE[/h1]

Localization sheet is now available for everyone who wants to create new languages. English (standard), Portuguese, German, French and Creole are available thanks to the community. Chinese and Russian are available only with the Google Translator version and we will soon have some people checking if it makes any sense soon. 

If you want to help the community with a new language, you can join our discussions at our Discord server. We have a channel called #oos-localization for announcements, suggestions and chat around this feature.

[h1]CHANGES AND ENHANCEMENTS:
[/h1]

- VFX for when the aliens prepare to get inside a workstation and for the fruits becoming dirt after becoming rotten were changed.

- Enhanced animation for sitting (and sleeping) on armchairs. The character sits faster and has a proper resting animation over the furniture piece.

- The doors were changed (even more) so that the animations for opening them won’t teleport the layer to the dirt and the character’s change of position will look smoother.

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

General
- Maximum number of aliens per room (1 to 4 players) reduced from 4/6/8/10 to 4/5/6/6;
- Starting dirty floor cells to trash bags ratio increased from 15 to 20, meaning that less trash bags will be generated at the start;
- Refrigerator item slots increased from 6 to 8;
- Timer until the first alien spawn (1 to 4 players) increased from 30/15/10/0 to 30/15/10/10;
- Alien spawn cooldown (1 to 4 players) increased from 80/30/20/10 to 80/30/20/20;
- Numbers of eggs upon game start (1 to 4 players) reduced from -1/0/1/2 to -1/0/1/1, with -1 meaning it will wait one cycle before increasing the number over time;
- Time aliens spend hiding under appliances (1 to 4 players) reduced 25/30/35/40 > 20/20/20/20.

Shop prices
- Portrait’s price increased from 15 to 20;
- Bucket’s price reduced from 45 to 40;
- Rug’s price reduced from 30 to 25.

Recycler rewards
- Pumpkin’s value increased from 5 to 8;
- Trash Bag’s value increased from: 4 to 6;
- Salad’s value increased from 8 to 11;
- Chicken’s value increased from 8 to 13.

[h1]UI[/h1]

- Shop’s portrait icons for the items have been improved to be more coherent. 

- Shopping UI reworked to better fit the new needs of the decorations. The description is now closer to the focus of the players while shopping. This feature is still a work in progress, even though it is fully functional.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- Names for item boxes and cocooned player’s interface are no longer invisible.
- Bookshelf only builds on walls again. The floating bookshelf is no longer a thing.
- Inactive rooms now have their appliances and their doors get dirt, so that they are still a threat to players even with the aliens on standby state.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.6.02b11
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Here are the patch notes for the version v0.6.02b11. For this update, we prioritized getting what we already have in the game to a better state, in general. That means that we prioritized bug fixes and enhancements over new features. Those tagged as [COM] were issues reported by the community, and we thank you all for that.

[h1]LOCALIZATION/TRANSLATION[/h1]

An interesting fact about our Early Access release is that, until the moment of this update, more than half of it's purchases were made in Asian countries! The reasons behind that are still unclear to us, but it made us rethink our plans of dealing with language and translations only closer to the full release.

But to do that while we create new features and items every week without having half of the game's translation regularly outdated and broken is challenging, to say the least. We decided to approach this as we did with GoPP and enable the community to change the language files until we get to a more stable build and translate it in a professional level.

This feature is still not available to the players, but If you want to help the community with a new language as soon as we release it, you can join our discussions at our Discord server. We have a channel called #oos-localization especially for announcements, suggestions and chat around this feature.

[h1]CHANGES AND ENHANCEMENTS[/h1]

- A new track for one of the game's music layers was added. This makes the transition between the early and the late game's music less abrupt.

- The Salad Bowl, a new fruit-based food, was added to the game. The chicken is now made by placing aliens in the microwave (eww). But seriously, we felt like we needed more choices regarding the act of eating and allowing the aliens to be cooked doubled the number of possibilities for the players.

- Now the room's fog is working with 3 states: When the room is totally closed, when it is powered off, and when it is on. This further helps us communicate the consequences of removing a battery from a socket, for example.

- New animation where the truck leaves the house's porch after "dropping" the players there. This is a first step towards using the truck as context for the shop delivery in the future.

- The doors were changed so they don't visually go through the walls when open. That was more of a visual issue that bothered us for quite some time, but we are sure some will agree they strongly affected our perception of the game's level of polishing.

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33859462/643f56ff043e144c4249d1375b715008cf73acda.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33859462/b27bc918f287218372fe12cf8abff4d0074ae7ff.gif[/img]

- Cooking a fruit now results in a Salad, instead of the vegan alien.
- Hunger rebalanced for the addition of the Salad, that can be used twice. Chickens can now be used 4 times instead of 3.
- Food-related values changed:
- max hunger: 280 -> 300
- fruit: 50 (1/2/3/4 players)
- salad: recovers 120 (1 player), 100 (2/3/4 players)
- chicken: recovers 180 (1 player), 150 (2/3/4 players)

[h1]UI[/h1]

- Settings window with new layout.
- Now it's possible to change Refresh Rate and Language in the settings window.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- Fixed screen canvas anchor for 4:3 aspect ratio and ultra wide monitors. The game should look as intended in those monitors now.
- Kitchen Table is no longer transparent.
- Cleaning Robot now reaches rooms further away from its base and he always comes back to cleaning after recharging.
- Alien eggs now always spawn on the right side of the door.
- Victory title screen adjusted.
- [COM]: Now it is possible to give food/items on players who passed out while they interacted with something.
- [COM] Rooms no longer have a chance to spawn without doors.
- [COM] Items don't float on an invisible ceiling anymore.
- [COM] Characters can no longer walk through the shower while it is being used.
- [COM] Any given resolution only appears once in the setting screen, instead of having repeated options.
- [COM] The timer for manually opened doors now pause with the game.
- [COM] Powered doors no longer shake as if they were about to close.
- [COM] Audio settings no longer reset when the game restarts.

notes.title: Out of Space is out now on Early Access!
notes.content:
Out of Space is now available in Early Access!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33859462/e875386bbec486b7213f0f5dc58c79722468182a.png[/img]

Our game is currently purchasable through Steam! Important to state that the game is fully playable, but still in development. This means that those who choose to get the game now will be joining us while we learn what the community likes and expects from the game and use that to make it better for everyone.

It's going to be great to have the game accessible for players outside our Discord Community as well! Open development has been our thing for a while and we can't wait to open it even more. Talking about the community, big thanks to all of the members who helped us so far! You rock, honestly.

If you are interested in joining us along this Early Access journey, you can get the game with 15% OFF on the link below:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/400080/Out_of_Space/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/400080/Out_of_Space/[/url]

[h1]What is Out of Space?[/h1]

Strategy co-op multiplayer game about living on a spaceship with your roommates. You'll need to generate resources, take care of a deadly alien infestation, upgrade your appliances and build your own sustainable space home. Living together is never easy, especially when you are in outer space!

[h1]Why Early Access?[/h1]

Our process of developing games has always been very open to the community in the past. We usually show our games under development in more than 10 events throughout the year and we find that to be the best approach to making games. We want to make the game for the community, and instead of us trying to guess what you want, why not making it an open process?

Our project Out of Space has already benefited from the feedback of the community during its first versions. Since 2018 we're doing livestreams on Twitch/Youtube and keeping everyone engaged in our official Discord Server. 

By releasing this game in Early Access, we hope to continue to grow our community and get more people involved in its development.

[h1]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?
[/h1]
We plan to have it on Early Access throughout 2019, but we're open to extend it depending on the community feedback.”

[h1]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?
[/h1]
We want that the final version of the game to give a sense of completion to the player, with missions, achievements and unlockables, a complete tutorial and the ability to play with your friends or anyone online. The main goal is to make a game interesting enough to keep you going back for more for every match. Right now, we have a fun and almost feature complete match, but we lack persistence and progression to enhance the game’s replayability.

[h1]What is the current state of the Early Access version?
[/h1]
Out of Space contains the most important features of the in-game match: The ability to buy and build new technology, the need for taking care of your stamina/fatigue and your hunger, the procedural level generation, the basic resources, batteries and organic materials, also the basic enemy system and AI. Also, right now, the game is only playable as local multiplayer or solo.

[h1]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?
[/h1]
We plan to have the game during Early Access with a fixed discount of 15%. After that, the game will be launched with the full price.

[h1]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?
[/h1]
Our plan is to make the community a big part of the development process so, every 2 weeks we will have the same cycle of: 
- Gather and analyse all feedback and analytics from past cycle.
- Plan the current cycle of bug fixing, updates and features.
Inform the community on Discord and Steam Forums about the current cycle and upcoming features.
- Start production and continuously keep track of the community feedback.
- Every Thursday 4pm (EST), the dev team will do a live streaming about the upcoming changes (Twitch, Youtube and Steam)
- Launch a beta version to the most interested players, and then release the stable version to everyone else at the end of the cycle.

Please join our official Discord Server to talk to us and help us improve this game. [url=http://discord.gg/beholdstudios]http://discord.gg/beholdstudios[/url]
